grip.note: the grip's centre is the model origin (the fist box covers y -2..+2); the model is y up with its big faces across z, and the converter turns it by a half turn about x into the weapon frame

note: The Sunweaver's staff, tier I (plain): a warm ash shaft with an iron foot and two gilt rings (one grain line and a few pits), a leather grip, a steel collar and a gilt sun 4.6 px across (a gilt square over a cream turned square, the eight-pointed star) on four short cream rays, holding the lit heart; the head sits low on the shaft, 35.4 px long; the heart (12 lit texels, the south face of its cube) is the same cube at the same sheet spot in all three tiers, so one sun_staff_e.png lights them all.
